== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and PC Errata articles for [[Solo Han]]. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged.
